comment: The two ratio knobs are stepped even though they look continuous: VerbCore.cc:156-159 truncates the knob to 48 steps and turns it into a divisor of 1 to 5 in twelfths. The maker's manual calls the TIME knob a decay time; VerbCore.cc:205 maps it to the comb feedback.
